tiers.core: Priority 1: checked first every run, in this order
tiers.topup: Priority 2-3: after core set, time permitting
tiers.primary: Official/primary sources: verification and watchlist checks

media.name: The Edge
media.notes: Browser-first. No paywall seen on tested stories (some Premium may truncate). No RSS/sitemap (all 404). Category pages are Next.js; article ids and bodies are in __NEXT_DATA__ (/node/{id}). Date: ALWAYS use meta article:published_time (+08:00) or the created epoch inside the article, NEVER the site date banner (it shows today on old stories). Property category is stale (nothing since 2022): use EdgeProp for property.

media.name: The Star
media.notes: No working RSS (/rss/business 404); sitemap only has section pages. Use the browser on Business, Property and Tech sections. StarPlus paywall on some stories: flag partial reads. Confirm date from article meta.

media.name: Malay Mail
media.notes: Full text, no paywall. Date: JSON-LD datePublished (+08:00).

media.name: TNGlobal (especially tech)
media.notes: Full text. Date: meta/JSON-LD in UTC, convert to MYT.

media.name: The Malaysian Reserve
media.notes: Full text; some "Premium" labels. Date: JSON-LD (+08:00).

media.name: Bernama
media.notes: General all-sections feed; filter business. Date: meta published_time in DD/MM/YYYY h:mm PM format.

media.name: NST / Business Times
media.notes: Full text, occasional premium; one status check timed out (retry). Date: JSON-LD (+08:00).

media.name: EdgeProp
media.notes: Property source replacing The Edge property category. Date not in meta/JSON-LD: read it from the page.

media.name: The Sun
media.notes: Mixed BM/EN feed. Date: meta + JSON-LD (+08:00).

media.name: FMT
media.notes: /category/business/ 404; use feed (business URLs inside). Date: JSON-LD UTC.

media.name: Sinar Harian
media.notes: Some premium. Date: JSON-LD (+08:00). No feed found.

media.name: China Press
media.notes: Easy/partial: paywall marker present; /feed/ redirects to listing. Date: meta + JSON-LD (+08:00).

media.name: Berita Harian
media.notes: Cloudflare 403 on pages/articles; feed gives headlines + pubDate only. Use browser for bodies.

media.name: Sin Chew
media.notes: Cloudflare 403 incl. /feed: browser only, may be not accessible.

media.name: Malaysiakini
media.notes: Hard paywall: headline + lede only. Date JSON-LD UTC.

media.name: KiniBiz
media.notes: Likely paywalled; feed ~10 items, pubDate only.

media.name: Nanyang
media.notes: Metered: ~350 chars readable; no feed. Date: meta + JSON-LD (+08:00).

primary.name: Bursa Malaysia announcements and company IR
primary.notes: Cloudflare 403 page and API: browser only. Use as a later watchlist check after core media; if it will not load, mark "not fully checked", never "no announcements".

primary.name: Bank Negara Malaysia
primary.notes: RSS 403 Access Denied; /press-release 404. Homepage links only.

primary.name: MCMC and telco operators
primary.notes: Dates not found statically (JS/PDF): use browser.

primary.name: CIDB
primary.notes: Low volume; page dates. Quick daily check.

primary.name: KPKT
primary.notes: Low volume; page dates. Quick daily check.

primary.name: MPOB
primary.notes: Low volume; /news 404, use homepage. Quick daily check.

primary.name: Government budget, policy and regulatory documents
primary.notes: Use when an item cites a policy document.
